Atlanta Jewelry Appraisal Leads

CaratBase sends local leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers in Atlanta. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

What you get

  • First 3 leads free
  • $40 per accepted lead
  • Optional Pro website widget, $12/month

Why CaratBase

Independent jewelers can get appraisal and gold-sale inquiries from the Atlanta area without running their own advertising.

FAQ

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.

Is CaratBase only in Atlanta? CaratBase is starting in Atlanta and plans to expand to other metros.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
